claims.claim: The client compresses image uploads only when the total exceeds 20 MiB, with a 2000 px maximum dimension and JPEG quality 0.82.

exclusions.reason: The current validated route sends accepted images directly to Gemini and has no separately evidenced OCR engine.
The current generation route checks for declared image MIME values and does not establish input-PDF support.
The route trusts File.type metadata; it does not verify magic bytes or decode images before accepting them.
The current compiler path posts generated source to configurable HTTP services; repository evidence does not establish isolation.
The Docker latexmk service is an alternate historical rail, not the current route default.
Conceptual ML-CV stages may appear only on the explicit proposed layer and never on the current master or cover.
The supplied artifacts provide structural counts but no reproducible accuracy, latency, confidence, or quality evaluation.
The file is described only as the supplied generated PDF.
